power.method: built-in rechargeable battery; USB-C solar-panel charger compatible

features: wire-free rechargeable battery, USB-C solar-charger compatible
spotlight with deterrence siren and voice alerts
60 ft night vision with 105 degree viewing angle
microSD or Night Owl recorder storage
release_notes: Night Owl CAM-B4LWNPU-FP: a wire-free battery-powered 2K spotlight bullet camera with two-way audio, deterrence siren, 60 ft night vision (105 degree view) and USB-C solar-charger compatibility. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted.

frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).
